_about: D1b: the meters' numbers, loaded by sim/core/fighter_data.gd into a MetersDef (f.md) and read by fighter.gd (regen, decay), damage.gd (damage_mul, comeback, composure), world/collateral.gd (sources) and director/beam.gd (beam_power). Sources: the meters read destruction, never a person (CD-05, docs/design/bystanders.md sections 3 and 4; Legal RL-257): structure mass brought down, craters, lived-in buildings emptied, a region broken, the brink. Mass gains are times the arena norm (collateral.json massRef over the arena's structure mass at its start). The range and start are pinned to 0 to 100 and 0 until F1.

sources._note: collateral devastation: a building anyone else brings down within `within` units of him (shortest arc), per unit of mass, times the arena norm. `within` is the reach of every row below too (a fall, a place emptied, the failing to protect)
... and a building he brings down himself
a lived-in building emptied within `within` of him (its first damage), times the norm
a cost to him, not a reward: a building falls inside the place he is fighting in while he is the nearest fighter to it, per unit of mass, times the norm

effects._note: ki regen - perPoint x anguish, at most cap (balance-targets section 13: 0.01, at most -1)
damage bonus while below; 0 = off (balance-targets.md section 4b ruling 6)
damage x (1 + cap x (1 - vitality)^2): stronger the closer to the brink (GD-B09)
